6668-annette-the-metis-spy-a-heroine-of-.creator: Unknown

Here and there, also, upon the mellow level, stood a clump of poplars or white oaks--prim like virgins without suitors, with their robes drawn close about them; but when over the unmeasured plain the wind blew, they bowed their heads gracefully, as a company of eastern girls when the king commands.

arxiv-2011-03491.title: Optimization-based Trajectory Planning for Tethered Aerial Robots*
arxiv-2011-03491.creator: S. Martínez-Rozas, D. Alejo, F. Caballero, L. Merino
arxiv-2011-03491.description: Abstract This paper presents a non-linear optimization method for trajectory planning of tethered aerial robots. Particularly, the paper addresses the planning problem of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) linked to an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) by means of a tether. The result is a collision-free trajectory for UAV and tether, assuming the UGV position is static.

arxiv-2012-06987.title: Estimating Spread of Contact-Based Contagions in a Population Through Sub-Sampling
arxiv-2012-06987.creator: Sepanta Zeighami, Cyrus Shahabi, John Krumm
arxiv-2012-06987.description: Abstract . Physical contacts result in the spread of various phenomena such as viruses, gossips, ideas, packages and marketing pamphlets across a population. The spread depends on how people move and co-locate with each other, or their mobility patterns. How far such phenomena spread has significance for both policy making and personal decision making, e.g.

arxiv-2104-00127.title: Experimental verification of arcsine laws in mesoscopic non-equilibrium systems
arxiv-2104-00127.creator: Raunak Dey, Avijit Kundu, Biswajit Das, Ayan Banerjee
arxiv-2104-00127.description: Abstract A large number of processes in the mesoscopic world occur out of equilibrium, where the time course of a system evolution becomes immensely important since it is driven principally by dissipative effects. Non-equilibrium steady states (NESS) represent a crucial category in such systems, where relaxation timescales are comparable to the operational timescales.

arxiv-2105-06007.title: Far-from-equilibrium hydrodynamic simulations of ultrarelativistic nuclear collisions
arxiv-2105-06007.creator: Michael J. McNelis
arxiv-2105-06007.description: Abstract We develop a far-from-equilibrium hydrodynamic model to evolve ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions in event-by-event simulations. Anisotropic hydrodynamics is designed to better handle the strong and highly anisotropic expansion during the early stages of the collision. The large gradients cause conventional second-order viscous hydrodynamic approaches to break down at early times.

arxiv-2112-06612.title: Twisted Conjugacy in Big Mapping Class Groups
arxiv-2112-06612.creator: Sushil Bhunia, Swathi Krishna
arxiv-2112-06612.description: Abstract . Let G G be a group and φ \varphi be an automorphism of G G . Two elements x , y x,y of G G are said to be φ \varphi -twisted conjugate if y = g ​ x ​ φ ​ ( g ) − 1 y=gx\varphi(g)^{-1} for some g ∈ G g\in G .

arxiv-2205-12236.title: A Two-Stage Mechanism for Demand Response Markets
arxiv-2205-12236.creator: Bharadwaj Satchidanandan, Mardavij Roozbehani, and Munther A. Dahleh
arxiv-2205-12236.description: Abstract Demand response involves system operators using incentives to modulate electricity consumption during peak hours or when faced with an incidental supply shortage. However, system operators typically have imperfect information about their customers’ baselines, that is, their consumption had the incentive been absent.

arxiv-2207-07614.title: Fixed Points and Noetherian Topologies
arxiv-2207-07614.creator: Aliaume Lopez
arxiv-2207-07614.description: Abstract Noetherian spaces are a generalisation of well-quasi-ordering to topologies, that can be used to prove termination of programs. They find applications in the verification of transitions systems, that are better described using topology. The goal of this paper is to allow the systematic description of computations using inductively defined datatypes using Noetherian spaces.

arxiv-2210-10302.title: CFAR based NOMP for Line Spectral Estimation and Detection
arxiv-2210-10302.creator: Menghuai Xu, Jiang Zhu, Jun Fang, Ning Zhang, Zhiwei Xu
arxiv-2210-10302.description: Abstract The line spectrum estimation problem is considered in this paper. We propose a CFAR-based Newtonized OMP (NOMP-CFAR) method which can maintain a desired false alarm rate without the knowledge of the noise variance. The NOMP-CFAR consists of two steps, namely, an initialization step and a detection step. In the initialization step, NOMP is employed to obtain candidate sinusoidal components.

arxiv-2303-10985.title: A Column Generation Approach for Radiation Therapy Patient Scheduling with Planned Machine Unavailability and Uncertain Future Arrivals
arxiv-2303-10985.creator: Sara Frimodig, Per Enqvist, Jan Kronqvist
arxiv-2303-10985.description: Abstract The number of cancer cases per year is rapidly increasing worldwide. In radiation therapy (RT), radiation from linear accelerators is used to kill malignant tumor cells. Scheduling patients for RT is difficult both due to the numerous medical and technical constraints, and because of the stochastic inflow of patients with different urgency levels.

arxiv-2308-07667.title: Ramsey-type results on parameters related to domination
arxiv-2308-07667.creator: Jin Sun
arxiv-2308-07667.description: Abstract There is a philosophy to discover Ramsey-type theorem: given a graph parameter μ \mu , characterize the family ℋ \mathcal{H} of graphs which satisfies that every ℋ \mathcal{H} -free graph G G has bounded parameter μ \mu . The classical Ramsey’s theorem deals the parameter μ \mu as the number of vertices. It also has a corresponding connected version.

arxiv-2311-08884.title: CREPE Notes: A new method for segmenting pitch contours into discrete notes
arxiv-2311-08884.description: Abstract Tracking the fundamental frequency (f0) of a monophonic instrumental performance is effectively a solved problem with several solutions achieving 99% accuracy. However, the related task of automatic music transcription requires a further processing step to segment an f0 contour into discrete notes.

arxiv-2401-05803.title: Impact of the molecular resonances on the C 12 + C 12 {}^{12}\mathrm{C}+{}^{12}\mathrm{C} fusion reaction rate Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2401-05803.creator: Yasutaka Taniguchi, Masaaki Kimura
arxiv-2401-05803.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yasutaka Taniguchi, Masaaki Kimura. The properties of the low-energy C 12 + C 12 {}^{12}\mathrm{C}+{}^{12}\mathrm{C} molecular resonances, which potentially enhance the fusion reaction rate at low temperatures, have been investigated by a full-microscopic nuclear model employing various nuclear energy density functionals. We show that some density functionals plausibly describe the observed high-spin C 12 + C 12 {}^{12}\mathrm{C}+{}^{12}\mathrm{C} molecular resonances and predict many 0 + 0^{+} and 2 + 2^{+} resonances at low energies, which enhance the reaction rate.

arxiv-2407-00738.title: Engineering an Efficient Object Tracker for Non-Linear Motion
arxiv-2407-00738.creator: Momir Adžemović, Predrag Tadić, Andrija Petrović, Mladen Nikolić
arxiv-2407-00738.description: Abstract The goal of multi-object tracking is to detect and track all objects in a scene while maintaining unique identifiers for each, by associating their bounding boxes across video frames. This association relies on matching motion and appearance patterns of detected objects. This task is especially hard in case of scenarios involving dynamic and non-linear motion patterns.

arxiv-2409-02095.title: DepthCrafter: Generating Consistent Long Depth Sequences for Open-world Videos
arxiv-2409-02095.creator: Wenbo Hu 1* †, Xiangjun Gao 2*, Xiaoyu Li 1* †, Sijie Zhao 1, Yong Zhang 1, Long Quan 2, Ying Shan 3, 1]
arxiv-2409-02095.description: Abstract Estimating video depth in open-world scenarios is challenging due to the diversity of videos in appearance, content motion, camera movement, and length. We present DepthCrafter, an innovative method for generating temporally consistent long depth sequences with intricate details for open-world videos, without requiring any supplementary information such as camera poses or optical flow.

arxiv-2410-04550.title: Finite-Lens Effect on Self-Lensing in detached White Dwarfs-Main Sequence Binary Systems
arxiv-2410-04550.creator: Sedighe Sajadian, Hossein Fatheddin
arxiv-2410-04550.description: Abstract In an edge-on and detached binary system, including a white dwarf (WD) and a main-sequence star (WDMS), when the source star is passing behind the compact companion its light is bent and magnified. Meanwhile, some part of its images’ area is obscured by the WD’s disk.

arxiv-2411-18525.title: RG-Flow Renormalized One-Loop Corrections to the Power Spectrum in USR Inflation
arxiv-2411-18525.creator: Haidar Sheikhahmadi a, Amin Nassiri-Rad b , a {}^{b},^{a}
arxiv-2411-18525.description: Abstract The nature of one-loop corrections to long-wavelength CMB-scale modes in single-field inflation models with an intermediate ultra-slow-roll (USR) phase remains a subject of active debate. In this work, we perform a detailed investigation into the regularization and renormalization of these one-loop corrections to the curvature perturbation power spectrum.

arxiv-2508-14881.title: Compute-Optimal Scaling for Value-Based Deep RL
arxiv-2508-14881.creator: Preston Fu, Oleh Rybkin, Zhiyuan Zhou, Michal Nauman, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, Aviral Kumar
arxiv-2508-14881.description: Abstract Abstract: As models grow larger and training them becomes expensive, it becomes increasingly important to scale training recipes not just to larger models and more data, but to do so in a compute-optimal manner that extracts maximal performance per unit of compute.

arxiv-2602-22535.title: Evaluating the resolution of AI-based accelerated MR reconstruction using a deep learning-based model observer
arxiv-2602-22535.creator: Zitong Yu 1, Rongping Zeng, Frank Samuelson, Prabhat Kc 2
arxiv-2602-22535.description: Abstract We developed a deep learning-based model observer (DLMO) to evaluate a multi-coil sensitivity encoding parallel MR imaging system at different acceleration factors on the Rayleigh discrimination task as a surrogate measure of resolution. We inserted Gaussian-convolved doublet and singlet signals with different intensities and lengths into the white matter area of synthetic brain images.

pmc-10596834.title: 11.Q. Round table: Supporting migrants and ethnic minorities in crises through inclusive emergency policies and actions
pmc-10596834.creator: Organised by: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (Finland), Uppsala University (Sweden), Koç University (Turkey), Chair persons: Esperanza Diaz (Norway)
pmc-10596834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundDuring Covid-19, it was evident that crisis preparedness and response measures did not sufficiently consider the needs and living context of refugees and other migrants, and ethnic minorities. While not all persons belonging to these groups had greater challenges during Covid-19 compared with majority populations, they were more likely to experience social and health disadvantage and barriers to accessible and reliable risk communications.

pmc-10610235.title: Anti-Inflammatory Effect of Cinnamomum japonicum Siebold’s Leaf through the Inhibition of p38/JNK/AP-1 Signaling

pmc-10610235.description: Cinnamomum japonicum Siebold (CJ) branch bark, commonly known as Japanese cinnamon, has been used for various culinary and medicinal applications for many centuries. Although the efficacy of CJ branch bark’s anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity for the treatment of various diseases has been confirmed, the efficacy of CJ leaves (CJLs) has not been examined.

pmc-11494643.title: A General and Scalable Method toward Enantioenriched C2-Substituted Azetidines Using Chiral tert-Butanesulfinamides
pmc-11494643.creator: Daniel Zelch, Christopher M Russo, Kirsten J Ruud, Matthew C O’Reilly
pmc-11494643.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Diverse ranges of chiral nitrogen-containing heterocycles serve as a molecular toolbox for modulating a wide array of biological processes, but enantioenriched production of smaller chiral heterocycles is a bottleneck. There is a lack of general approaches for the stereoselective preparation of chiral 4-membered monocyclic C2-substituted azetidines, where many routes to different substitution types are possible, but no simple and common approach exists.

pmc-12600027.description: The pineal gland is a neuroendocrine gland located in the epithalamus. Brain metastases from adenocarcinoma of upper gastrointestinal tract occur in less than 1.5% of patients, yet no clear data about the incidence of metastases in the pineal region are available.

pmc-13398222.title: Ensemble Machine Learning for Malaria Diagnosis in Resource-Limited Settings Using Clinical and Demographic Features
pmc-13398222.creator: Panashe Nyengera, Hilary Takunda Takawira, Farai Fredric Mlambo
pmc-13398222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Sub-Saharan Africa suffers the greatest impact of malaria, with the 2024 Health Organization (WHO )report stating that the region represents 94% of global cases and 95% of deaths. Challenges in malaria elimination stem from weak health systems and limitations of traditional diagnostic methods like microscopy and malaria Rapid Diagnostic Tests (mRDTs), which result in missed diagnoses, delays in treatment, and preventable fatalities in resource-limited settings.

pmc-13519267.creator: Volodymyr Polishchuk, Vladyslava Skidan
pmc-13519267.description: Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams are widely used in software engineering education and practice. However, research on real-world UML usage has been constrained by the limited availability of large-scale, openly accessible, and structurally annotated diagram collections, with existing resources differing in size, format, and the absence of per-diagram type labels.
